query: select version,active,payload->>'status' as payload_status,payload->>'effective_from' as effective_from,jsonb_array_length(coalesce(payload->'rules','[]'::jsonb)) as rules_count,(select count(*) from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(payload->'rules','[]'::jsonb)) x where x->>'enabled'='true') as enabled_count from public.progression_rules;
